source: Claude, d'après l'arbre du dépôt et le README
explication_en: The plugin declares hooks that, at session start and at stop, enforce the response style and trigger the done-or-not report. The skills complement each other: whats-next reads the file maintained by big-picture, whose census.sh measures the age of the code, and evals/run.sh scores behavior with score.py.
